nodes.label: Retry Logic for 2K Evaluator
nodes.rationale: If overall_score < 70, inject retry_prompt into enhanced article generation, re-run 1E through 2K, max 2 retries. If critical_blockers exist, always halt for human review regardless of score. This gate prevents low-quality content from reaching publish.

nodes.label: Hybrid Image Generation Strategy
nodes.rationale: Featured image and infographic use DALL-E 3 for high quality and text rendering. Supporting images use Pollinations.ai (free FLUX.1) to offset cost. Total image cost ~$0.12 per article vs $0.30 all-DALL-E.

nodes.label: EEAT+HCU+EAV Analysis Rationale
nodes.rationale: Deep multi-dimensional analysis using Claude Sonnet for structured reasoning. Separated from the evaluator to provide granular EEAT/HCU/EAV scores before quality and SEO/GEO assessment. Feeds into both 2J and 2K.
